Grammar: 不 changes to the second tone (bú) before a syllable in the fourth tone

Grammar: Tone Marking (tone mark goes on the vowel with the widest mouth opening in the order a, o, e, i, u, ü; exception iu marks u; neutral tone unmarked)
Grammar: Abbreviation (iou, uei, uen after an initial are written iu, ui, un, e.g. niu, gui, lun)
Practice list: syllables for tone-mark positions (xuéxiào, bāng máng, lánqiú, nǚ'ér, yóu yǒng, shǒubiǎo, zhōngyú, gōngsī, shíjiān, shēntǐ, kǎoshì, guójiā, bàozhǐ, hǎochī, xièxie, kèqi)
Practice list: syllables with abbreviated finals (xiūxi, shuì jiào, lúnchuán, niúnǎi, píjiǔ, ángguì, liúyán, kāi huì, tǎolùn, zúqiú, Lúndūn, shīrùn, cánkuì, shuǐguǒ, táozuì, shùnlì)
Practice list: neutral-tone syllables (zhuōzi, fángzi, yǐzi, guìzi, tāmen, rénmen, wǒmen, dìdi, yīfu, érzi, xǐhuan, rènshi, xiānsheng, péngyou, wǎnshang, piàoliang)
Practice list: initials j/q/x (xiūxi, jījí, jīqì, xiǎoqū, xīngqī, xiāngjiāo, xìngqù, jìxù)
Practice list: initials z/c/s (xǐ zǎo, dǎsǎo, sān cì, zìjǐ, zuótiān, zǎoshang, cāochǎng, Hànzì)
Pinyin: u vs ü articulation (both rounded; ü has tongue forward with tip against lower teeth, u has tongue pulled back without touching)
Practice table: ü spelling and pronunciation (ü, üe, üan, ün; ju, jue, juan, jun; qu, que, quan, qun; xu, xue, xuan, xun)
Practice list: initials zh/ch/sh/r (zhīshi, chúshī, shēngrì, shàng chē, rènshi, chángshí, shìshí, chāorén, ránshāo, rènao, chū chāi, Chángchéng, shǒushù, shāngchǎng, chāoshì, chōng zhí)
Practice pairs: an-ang, ian-iang, uan-uang, en-eng, in-ing, uen-ueng
Grammar: 哪 + measure word/noun + noun (e.g. 哪本书, 哪个人, 你是哪国人)
Grammar: 的 can be omitted when the noun after it is a kinship term or indicates a person
Grammar: Stroke Order - horizontal precedes vertical (十, 工)
Grammar: Stroke Order - left-falling precedes right-falling (八, 人)

Lesson 3 Text 1: In the school (你叫什么名字?)
你叫什么名字？ (Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?) - What's your name?
我叫李月。 (Wǒ jiào Lǐ Yuè.) - My name is Li Yue.
Lesson 3 Text 2: In the classroom (你是老师吗?)
Lesson 3 Text 3: In the school (你是中国人吗?)
你是老师吗？ (Nǐ shì lǎoshī ma?) - Are you a teacher?
我不是老师，我是学生。 (Wǒ bú shì lǎoshī, wǒ shì xuésheng.) - No, I'm not. I'm a student.
你是中国人吗？ (Nǐ shì Zhōngguó rén ma?) - Are you Chinese?
我不是中国人，我是美国人。 (Wǒ bú shì Zhōngguó rén, wǒ shì Měiguó rén.) - No, I'm not. I'm American.
你叫什么名字？ (Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?) - What's your name? (example (1) of the interrogative pronoun 什么)
这是什么？ (Zhè shì shénme?) - What is this? (example (2) of the interrogative pronoun 什么)
这是什么书？ (Zhè shì shénme shū?) - What book is this? (example (3) of the interrogative pronoun 什么)
李月是老师。 (Lǐ Yuè shì lǎoshī.) - Li Yue is a teacher. (example of the 是 sentence)
我是美国人。 (Wǒ shì Měiguó rén.) - I am American. (example of the 是 sentence)
我不是老师。 (Wǒ bú shì lǎoshī.) - I am not a teacher. (negative 是 sentence)
你是美国人吗？ (Nǐ shì Měiguó rén ma?) - Are you American? (example of the 吗 question)
你是中国人吗？ (Nǐ shì Zhōngguó rén ma?) - Are you Chinese? (example of the 吗 question)
你是老师吗？ (Nǐ shì lǎoshī ma?) - Are you a teacher? (example of the 吗 question)

Lesson 3 Application 1: Pair work - introduce yourselves
我叫李月，我是中国人，我是老师。 (Wǒ jiào Lǐ Yuè, wǒ shì Zhōngguó rén, wǒ shì lǎoshī.) - My name is Li Yue, I am Chinese, I am a teacher.

Lesson 4 Text 1: In the classroom (她是谁?)
她是谁？ (Tā shì shéi?) - Who is she?
她是我的汉语老师，她叫李月。 (Tā shì wǒ de Hànyǔ lǎoshī, tā jiào Lǐ Yuè.) - She is my Chinese teacher. Her name is Li Yue.
Lesson 4 Text 2: In the library (你是哪国人?)
Lesson 4 Text 3: Looking at the photo (他是谁?)
你是哪国人？ (Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?) - Which country are you from?
我是美国人。你呢？ (Wǒ shì Měiguó rén. Nǐ ne?) - The United States. What about you?
我是中国人。 (Wǒ shì Zhōngguó rén.) - I'm Chinese.
他是谁？ (Tā shì shéi?) - Who is he?
他是我同学。 (Tā shì wǒ tóngxué.) - He is my classmate.
她呢？她是你同学吗？ (Tā ne? Tā shì nǐ tóngxué ma?) - What about her? Is she your classmate?
她不是我同学，她是我朋友。 (Tā bú shì wǒ tóngxué, tā shì wǒ péngyou.) - No, she isn't. She is my friend.
谁是李月？ (Shéi shì Lǐ Yuè?) - Who is Li Yue? (example of the interrogative pronoun 谁)
她是谁？ (Tā shì shéi?) - Who is she? (example of the interrogative pronoun 谁)
他是谁？ (Tā shì shéi?) - Who is he? (example of the interrogative pronoun 谁)
哪本书？ (Nǎ běn shū?) - Which book? (example of 哪 + measure word + noun)
哪个人？ (Nǎ gè rén?) - Which person? (example of 哪 + measure word + noun)
你是哪国人？ (Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?) - Which country are you from? (example of 哪 + noun + noun)
李月是我的老师。 (Lǐ Yuè shì wǒ de lǎoshī.) - Li Yue is my teacher. (example of 的)
这是我的书。 (Zhè shì wǒ de shū.) - This is my book. (example of 的)
她不是我同学，她是我朋友。 (Tā bú shì wǒ tóngxué, tā shì wǒ péngyou.) - She isn't my classmate, she is my friend. (的 omitted before a person noun)
我不是老师，我是学生。你呢？ (Wǒ bú shì lǎoshī, wǒ shì xuésheng. Nǐ ne?) - I'm not a teacher, I'm a student. What about you? (example of 呢)
她叫李月。他呢？ (Tā jiào Lǐ Yuè. Tā ne?) - Her name is Li Yue. What about him? (example of 呢)
我是美国人。你呢？ (Wǒ shì Měiguó rén. Nǐ ne?) - I'm American. What about you? (example of 呢)
